name: fruitboard
description: Local-first FL Studio project library and production tracker

scripts.check: pnpm verify:toolchains && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tools scripts tests apps && cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tools scripts tests apps && cargo fmt --all --check
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:docs && pnpm lint:scripts && pnpm --recursive --if-present lint && pnpm lint:rust
scripts.lint:scripts: node --check scripts/lib/toolchain-policy.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-sqlite-version.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-toolchains.mjs && node --check tests/desktop-boundary.test.mjs && node --check tests/toolchain-policy.test.mjs && node --check tests/workspace-policy.test.mjs
